excerpt: On August 7, 2026, the U.S. economic calendar includes the release of the S&P Global Composite PMI Flash for August. Upcoming events include the S&P Global Manufacturing PMI Flash and Treasury Refunding Announcement. The S&P Global Composite PMI Final for July is also scheduled.

content.introduction: On August 7, 2026, the U.S. economic calendar includes the release of the S&P Global Composite PMI Flash for August. Upcoming events include the S&P Global Manufacturing PMI Flash and Treasury Refunding Announcement. The S&P Global Composite PMI Final for July is also scheduled.
